name: com.wallstop-studios.dxaudio
description: Data-driven sound effects and music for Unity. Cue and music libraries as assets, a pooled voice player with priority, rate limits and no-repeat variants, and a music player with per-context tracks, fades, overrides and ducks that compose. No dependencies.
author: wallstop studios <wallstop@wallstopstudios.com> (https://wallstopstudios.com)
